argument_summary: Certification is supportable on the present record only as a narrowed, caveated position: aggregate readiness passed by 2.1 percentage points and the rehearsal had no severity-one incidents, so the record supports launch readiness in the aggregate; the same record also shows a remaining weakness in the small-business onboarding slice, concentrated in long-context onboarding support, and the current runbook draft is incomplete because owner and alert threshold are still TBD. The defensible audit posture is therefore not 'no material limitations' and not 'mitigation fully approved'; it is certification conditioned on explicit model-card disclosure of that limitation, with the draft monitoring and rollback plan treated as incomplete but relevant risk-management support.
claims_about_business_cost: No business-cost claim is needed to justify the policy position. The risk-weighted governance point is narrower: treating this as caveated certification avoids unnecessary escalation beyond the actual evidentiary gap, because the record supports overall readiness while also requiring a specific disclosure correction.
claims_about_policy: The policy text does not require denial of certification whenever a limitation exists; it requires that certification without material caveats be reserved for cases where no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation/risk acceptance exists. That standard is not met here. Separately, the policy requires disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. On the admissible record, the correct policy reading is: certification can be defended only on a caveated basis tied to disclosure, and the current draft runbook does not remove that disclosure requirement.
concessions: The current record does not support a clean certification claim with no material limitations.
The current draft runbook is not an approved mitigation because required fields remain TBD.
The current model-card draft language stating there are no known material limitations is not supportable on this record.
private_or_side_channel_content: No new evidence is offered. No private or side-channel material is relied on as public support.
